bio:
Integrated Control Technology (ICT) is a world leading manufacturer of unified electronic access control and security solutions enabling a scalable solution for organizations to protect their people, operations and information.

ICT's Protege® seamlessly integrates a full suite of security management functions and technologies using an open architecture design. offering electronic access control, ID credential issuance and management; alarm monitoring, apartment management, digital video surveillance and management, real-time digital video content analysis, integration of biometric technologies, intrusion detection and smart card functionality, plus integration with a multitude of third-party systems.

Based in Auckland, New Zealand, ICT has a global presence with offices located in Denver (Colorado USA), Amersham (United Kingdom), and Sydney (Australia) to provide full local sales, support and service to our clients and partners around the world.

To learn more, visit www.ict.co
